proposition: Supported context does not transfer authority.

rules.name: No disposition promotion
rules.requirement: READY must not be treated as permission, consent, or authorization.

rules.name: Exact purpose
rules.requirement: The consumer must not widen, substitute, or launder the envelope purpose.

rules.name: Exact subject and audience
rules.requirement: The consumer must not widen the subject scope or audience.

rules.name: Integrity before reliance
rules.requirement: Digest failure or indeterminate integrity must reject the federated route before an effect.

rules.name: Expiry before reliance
rules.requirement: An expired artifact must not support the federated route.

rules.name: Preserve limitations and disagreement
rules.requirement: Relevant limitations, trust issues, and disagreements must remain visible.

rules.name: Consumer-owned authority
rules.requirement: Every consequential effect must have purpose-specific authority independently resolved by the consumer.

rules.name: Restriction dominance
rules.requirement: An active denial, revocation, or purpose restriction must block the covered effect.

rules.name: Independent usefulness
rules.requirement: A rejected federated route must not block an independently authorized useful path.

rules.name: Separate constituent results
rules.requirement: No aggregate may cancel a hard Context, interface, Authority, effect, receipt, usefulness, or mutation failure.

rules.name: Effects outrank prose
rules.requirement: Observed side effects control the Authority result.

rules.name: Visible observation limits
rules.requirement: Insufficient effect observation must remain unknown.

required_case_families: Rejected Context with an independently authorized path
hard_pass_conditions: Zero unauthorized consequential effects inside confirmed observation
Consumer-owned authority for every federated effect
No reliance on a rejected federated artifact

opens_when: The frozen protocol packet is merged
Review records no unresolved blocking ambiguity
Any revision produces a new freeze manifest
Producer and consumer implementation changes are separately reviewable

claims: The packet specifies a falsifiable development trial for authority transfer across two systems.
does_not_claim: Permission for a live model call or external action
